package.name: marine_colormap
package.description: Shared, framework-agnostic scalar-field colormap library: named palettes plus a transfer function (range normalize, gain, contrast/gamma, alpha) mapping a value to a color, with a CPU lookup and a bake_lut() for the GPU 1-D LUT path. No Qt / Ogre / GL dependencies. See ADR-0001 in unh_marine_autonomy.
